mapper.select: SELECT F.FAQ_ID AS faqId, F.CATEGORY_CD AS categoryCd, F.QUESTION AS question, F.ANSWER AS answer, F.VISIBLE_YN AS visibleYn, F.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, F.REG_DATE AS regDate, F.MOD_DATE AS modDate FROM TB_FAQ F WHERE F.VISIBLE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY F.SORT_ORDER ASC, F.FAQ_ID DESC

SELECT N.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, N.NOTICE_TYPE_CD AS noticeTypeCd, N.TITLE AS title, N.BODY AS body, N.WRITER_NAME AS writerName, TRIM(N.PIN_YN) AS pinYn, TRIM(N.VISIBLE_YN) AS visibleYn, N.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, N.REG_DATE AS regDate, N.MOD_DATE AS modDate FROM TB_NOTICE N WHERE TRIM(N.VISIBLE_YN) = 'Y' ORDER BY TRIM(N.PIN_YN) DESC, N.REG_DATE DESC, N.NOTICE_ID DESC

SELECT N.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, N.NOTICE_TYPE_CD AS noticeTypeCd, N.TITLE AS title, N.BODY AS body, N.WRITER_NAME AS writerName, TRIM(N.PIN_YN) AS pinYn, TRIM(N.VISIBLE_YN) AS visibleYn, N.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, N.REG_DATE AS regDate, N.MOD_DATE AS modDate FROM TB_NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND TRIM(N.VISIBLE_YN) = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_NOTICE SET VIEW_COUNT = NVL(VIEW_COUNT, 0) + 1 WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND TRIM(VISIBLE_YN) = 'Y'
